'''Kōsuke Kuwano''' (Japanese: '''桑野 晃輔''' ''Kuwano Kōsuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Kuwano was born on October 16, 1990 in {{wp|Hyōgo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. Kuwano's joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where his only role was [[Molayne]]. He is currently affiliated with Sunaoka Creative Artist.
